title: Deep links, verified app links and custom URL schemes
when: Links shared by email or chat should open a specific screen inside the installed app, or fall back to the website when the app is missing.
inputs: app id and signing certificate fingerprint
prompt:
Goal: https links on your domain open the matching screen in the app, verified by files on the domain, with the website as the fallback.
Steps:
1. One path scheme for web and app: https://example.com/orders/123 maps to route orders/:id.
2. Host /.well-known/assetlinks.json with the package name and the SHA256 fingerprint of the release signing certificate.
3. Host /.well-known/apple-app-site-association (JSON, no extension, no redirects) with appIDs and paths.
4. In the native projects add the intent filter with autoVerify="true" for the host, and the Associated Domains entry applinks:example.com.
5. In app code: App.addListener("appUrlOpen", (e) => router.go(new URL(e.url).pathname)); also read the launch URL with App.getLaunchUrl() on cold start.
6. Validate every incoming path against the route table; unknown paths go to home, and never run actions (pay, delete) straight from a link.
7. Custom schemes (fieldnotes://) are a fallback only; any app can claim them.
Quality bar:
- The same link works on the website when the app is not installed.
- Cold start and warm start both land on the right screen.
Pitfalls:
- Using the debug certificate fingerprint, so verification fails in the store build.
- Redirects on the well-known files.
Verify:
- [ ] Both well-known files parse as JSON.
- [ ] appUrlOpen and getLaunchUrl both route.
- [ ] Unknown paths fall back to home.
Output: .well-known/assetlinks.json, .well-known/apple-app-site-association, deeplinks.js and README steps.

examples.input: quero que o link do pedido abra direto no app
examples.output: assetlinks.json and site association file, appUrlOpen router with path whitelist, web fallback
